Viral Video Shows Man Warning Paparazzi About Reels

A video has gone viral showing an individual, identified as Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, humorously warning paparazzi about the consequences of creating reels. The man's statement, "Reel ke chakkar mein thuk jaoge" (roughly translating to 'You'll face trouble if you get caught up in making reels'), was captured and shared widely.
